C1834.title: Gaming Industry First: Hiring Water Army to "Poach Users" Ruled Unfair Competition, 2.03 Million Yuan in Damages
C1834.summary: On December 6, 2022, the Wuxi Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province ruled on an unfair competition case where game company A sued game company B. Company B had hired guild water armies to poach users, and company A claimed 5 million yuan (including 2 million in actual losses and 3 million in punitive damages). The court ordered company B to cease the malicious poaching and pay 2 million yuan in economic losses plus 30,000 yuan in reasonable costs, totaling 2.03 million yuan, while rejecting the punitive damages claim. This was the gaming industry's first ruling on user-poaching unfair competition.
